The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (noise/blur), which supports the high quality of the primary metal rendering. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.97) confirms the main object is coherent, but it does not rule out the subtle boundary issues noted by the Router. The severity ratings are appropriate; these are noticeable but do not destroy the image's utility.
